title: Mochizuki Honami — Looking For My Answer〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys!
I got to wondering yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How do you think they're gonna have us take our publicity photos?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How...? I mean, we'll probably have a professional at a photo studio take them for us, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But what if they ask us to do poses and stuff?! And I don't know what I'd wear! Are we supposed to make a fashion statement?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I don't know either...
I can't think of any particular poses... Aside from maybe the four of us making peace signs or something.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I doubt they'll be okay with that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was actually wondering about that as well, and I decided to look for some information on the subject.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I did some searches for what other bands have done for their publicity photos.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Hona's on her game!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, what did you find?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Most seem to have gone with a cool look. For example, having the members stood shoulder to shoulder or the photo taken in black and white.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds like what I've seen before!
Or like, having their chins held high while looking downwards and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, that's it.
You're really good at that, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! Ichi, you try it too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, me? Sure, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: From the photos I saw, most let their knees sag a little while standing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, like this...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
Now, stand your guitar up by holding just the headstock.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Like this...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, perfect! That's it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa, that's so cool...!
Ichi, you look like a total pro!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it isn't bad.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, you could take your bass and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No thanks.
I'll pass...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! Why?!
We should practice posing together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Practice? For publicity photos?
We should just try to be ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, you're wrong!
We gotta make the most of this opportunity by looking super cool!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because what we take is gonna be what's used on our website, in magazines and even on TV if we get there, forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Making our publicity photos is a part of our job as pros! We've gotta take this seriously!!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I think Shiho's starting to feel Saki's pressure...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But I agree with Saki...
Taking good publicity photos is important.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, why don't we try taking one right now to practice?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! Now! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Alright, fine...
Just one, okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, what should we do?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You looked up a lot of different ones, right, Honami? I'm fine with whichever style you liked best.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, Hona, tell us! You're the director!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, so...
It's not that I thought this one was the coolest, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If we could all...
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, we ended up just sitting in a circle and taking a picture from above... I'm not sure how to feel about that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, we literally just sat down.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know, but I liked this idea the most out of all the different photos I saw...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Achieving a cool look would be nice, but I also love the idea of just being ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess this is the best expression of who we really are...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I really love this style too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You do? Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, since these are going to be our very first publicity photos, we'll want to ask Mr. Shindo to help us see how we can make them look good.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Agreed.
And I'm not sure how much our practice just now is gonna help...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
Besides, we had a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start the practice we came here for.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Honami & Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay!
Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami, are your drums ready?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Yes.
I just got them all set up, so I'm ready whenever.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, here we go!
One, two, three, four!
